system.description: Any opponent that is reduced to half Hit Points or fewer while within 6 squares of you takes a -2 penalty on all attack rolls and Skill Checks for the duration of the encounter. This is a Mind-Affecting Fear effect.

prerequisite.text: Inspire Fear I talent, Inspire Fear II talent, Inspire Fear III talent, and Notorious (Infamy Talent Tree) talent
